description: This file defines the TaskRunner class and related utilities for managing and executing asynchronous tasks with support for setup, teardown, error handling, and timeout management within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TaskRunner
classes.description: Manages a list of tasks, executing them with support for setup, teardown, error handling, and timeout control.

classes.name: TimeoutWatcher
classes.description: Watches for timeout expiration and manages associated timers.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the task list.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks and performs cleanup, returning the final status.

methods.name: runDeferCleanup
methods.description: Runs tasks with deferred cleanup, handling signals, timeouts, and errors.
